notes: Governmental funds are modified cash basis (basis recorded as cash); business-type funds are accrual. beginning_cash/ending_cash are the governmental fund balances (63,692 / 799,262, p6), which equal total governmental fund assets (cash, CDs, county treasurer cash and investments; no liabilities, p4); ending_investments 588,970 is the investments line of the governmental funds balance sheet, informational and included in ending_cash. Governmental transfers are printed net per fund ('Transfer from (to) other funds'); transfers_in is the Total Governmental Funds net 175,000 (General +182,584, Sales Tax +12,355, Street -19,129, CRA -810). Business-type receipts total computed (operating revenues + nonoperating gain and grant income); disbursements total is the business-type expenses printed on the Statement of Activities (p2) = operating expenses 1,157,766 + interest expense 36,202. Balance sheet from the government-wide Statement of Net Position Total column (includes business-type capital assets and debt). Detail: General Fund from the departmental combining statement (pp17-18), so the General Fund budgetary comparison schedule (p11) is not recorded (no double counting); Street, Sales Tax, Escher, Foss and CRA from their budget schedules (pp12-16). No supplementary schedules for the enterprise funds. Read pages 1-18 of 18
